rules.statement: For a marriage to be valid under the Kandyan Marriage Ordinance, it must have been contracted according to the laws, institutions, and customs in force in Kandy before the date of the Ordinance No. 13 of 1859.
rules.supporting_quote: "This section, however, requires that the marriage should have been 'according to the laws, institutions, and customs in force in Kandy' before the date of the Ordinance No. 13 of 1859."
